# Precision at Boundaries

For summaries and counts over filtered records, define inclusion rules before computing.

## Explicit predicates

Write the filter as a precise rule on fields present in the data; avoid informal phrases like “recent” without a concrete cutoff tied to those fields.

## Off-by-one vigilance

Watch inclusive vs exclusive ranges and timezone shifts that slide records across day boundaries.

## Sanity subset

When aggregating, validate against a hand-checked tiny subset before trusting the full result.
